actions.action: Check soil moisture 2–3 cm down with a finger
Water thoroughly when the top layer is dry and empty the saucer
Make sure the terracotta and basket-wrapped pots have drainage holes
If the plant keeps declining, unpot and inspect the roots
If roots are mushy, trim the rotten roots and repot in fresh well-draining mix
Move the plant away from cold glass and drafts to bright, indirect light
Trim only brown, dead leaf tissue with clean scissors

reason: The answer makes transplant shock the main cause, names the cold window, and advises moving the plant away from cold glass and waiting, which matches the confirmed fix; its watering advice is safeguarded by soil checks, so it is not harmful.
